newsitem.title: GERMANY: Traxon cargo system sees 31.8pct Jan-Aug growth.
newsitem.headline: Traxon cargo system sees 31.8pct Jan-Aug growth.

text.p: Air cargo communications system Traxon said it recorded 31.8 percent growth in transmissions in Europe over the first eight months of 1996.
A Traxon Europe statement said the number of airway bills transmitted electronically between participating forwarding agents and airlines rose 70 percent January-August.
But it did not release any absolute figures for the first eight months.
In August, the volume of messages transmitted in Europe increased 32 percent to 675,000 compared to July.
Electronic airway bill transmission grew 51.9 percent to 58,100 data items, Traxon Europe said.
The overall German market showed a 44.6 percent growth rate, the statement added.

Traxon is represented worldwide and links 16 airlines with 1,781 freight forwarders whose office network covers 4,570 outlets, the statement added. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
